## Gráfica Asimetría y curtosis 

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 7

par(
  mfrow = c(1,4),
  mar = c(4,3.5,3,1),
  family = "sans"
)

# -------------------------
# 1. Distribución simétrica
# -------------------------
x1 <- rnorm(5000, 0, 1)

hist(
  x1,
  probability = TRUE,
  col = "#bfdbfe",
  border = "white",
  main = "Simétrica",
  sub = "Asimetría ≈ 0",
  xlab = "x",
  cex.main = 1.2,
  cex.sub = 1,
  cex.lab = 1.1
)

curve(
  dnorm(x, mean(x1), sd(x1)),
  add = TRUE,
  lwd = 3,
  col = "#1d4ed8"
)

abline(v = mean(x1),
       col = "#991b1b",
       lwd = 2,
       lty = 2)

# -------------------------
# 2. Sesgo positivo
# -------------------------
x2 <- rexp(5000, 0.5)

hist(
  x2,
  probability = TRUE,
  col = "#bbf7d0",
  border = "white",
  main = "Sesgo positivo",
  sub = "Cola hacia la derecha",
  xlab = "x",
  cex.main = 1.2,
  cex.sub = 1,
  cex.lab = 1.1
)

lines(
  density(x2),
  lwd = 3,
  col = "#15803d"
)

abline(v = mean(x2),
       col = "#991b1b",
       lwd = 2,
       lty = 2)

# -------------------------
# 3. Sesgo negativo
# -------------------------
x3 <- -rexp(5000, 0.5) + 8

hist(
  x3,
  probability = TRUE,
  col = "#fecaca",
  border = "white",
  main = "Sesgo negativo",
  sub = "Cola hacia la izquierda",
  xlab = "x",
  cex.main = 1.2,
  cex.sub = 1,
  cex.lab = 1.1
)

lines(
  density(x3),
  lwd = 3,
  col = "#b91c1c"
)

abline(v = mean(x3),
       col = "#7f1d1d",
       lwd = 2,
       lty = 2)

# -------------------------
# 4. Curtosis
# -------------------------
x4 <- rt(5000, df = 3)

hist(
  x4,
  probability = TRUE,
  breaks = 40,
  xlim = c(-8,8),
  col = "#ddd6fe",
  border = "white",
  main = "Alta curtosis",
  sub = "Colas pesadas",
  xlab = "x",
  cex.main = 1.2,
  cex.sub = 1,
  cex.lab = 1.1
)

lines(
  density(x4),
  lwd = 3,
  col = "#6d28d9"
)

curve(
  dnorm(x, mean(x4), sd(x4)),
  add = TRUE,
  lwd = 2,
  lty = 2,
  col = "black"
)

legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c("Distribución", "Normal"),
  col = c("#6d28d9", "black"),
  lwd = c(3,2),
  lty = c(1,2),
  bty = "n",
  cex = 0.9
)
```
